## Changes to `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml` (dev untouched)

```yaml
# overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

# Same base reference as dev overlay (e.g. ../../base)
resources:
  - ../../base

namespace: prod

patches:
  # 1. App deployment replicas: 2 -> 4
  - target:
      kind: Deployment
      name: app
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/replicas
        value: 4

  # 2. RDS instance class: db.t3.micro -> db.t3.medium
  - target:
      group: rds.aws.crossplane.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: DBInstance
      name: app-db
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/dbInstanceClass
        value: db.t3.medium

  # 3. Enable multi-AZ
  - target:
      group: rds.aws.crossplane.io
      version: v1beta1
      kind: DBInstance
      name: app-db
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/multiAZ
        value: true

# 4. S3 cross-region replication to us-west-2 (adds a new resource only in prod)
resources:
  - ../../base
  - replication-config.yaml
```

If the RDS/S3 resources are single documents rather than separate patch targets, you can use strategic merge patches instead:

```yaml
patchesStrategicMerge:
  - patch-rds.yaml
```

with `patch-rds.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: rds.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: DBInstance
metadata:
  name: app-db
spec:
  forProvider:
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
    multiAZ: true
```

**S3 cross-region replication** — `replication-config.yaml` (prod-only file, referenced only by the prod overlay):

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta2
kind: BucketReplicationConfiguration
metadata:
  name: app-assets-replication
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    roleRef:
      name: s3-replication-role
    rules:
      - id: replicate-to-us-west-2
        status: Enabled
        prefix: ""
        destination:
          bucketRef:
            name: app-assets-replica-usw2
          storageClass: STANDARD
```

## Why this is isolated

- **Only `overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml` was modified** plus one new file (`replication-config.yaml`) that lives under `overlays/prod/` and is referenced exclusively by it — kustomize will error if the dev overlay doesn't reference a file, and dev never sees these patches.
- **JSON6902/strategic-merge patches apply only at overlay render time**; `overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml` continues to render the base unchanged (replicas 2, db.t3.micro, single AZ, no replication).
- Verify isolation before committing:

```bash
kustomize build overlays/dev  > /tmp/dev.yaml
kustomize build overlays/prod > /tmp/prod.yaml
diff /tmp/dev.yaml /tmp/prod.yaml   # only the 4 intended deltas
```

Note: adjust `kind`/`group`/`name` in the patch targets to match your actual resource definitions in `infra/` (e.g. if RDS is managed via Terraform controller, the patch target would be `Object` with the appropriate spec path — the same patch structure applies).
